data.title: Rockstar 2FA / FlowerStorm Application ID and User-Agent Detection
data.description: Detects sign-ins associated with the Rockstar 2FA and FlowerStorm AiTM phishing kits (Storm-1575 lineage) by matching the hardcoded Office365 Application ID and User-Agent string used by these kits. Rockstar 2FA and its successor FlowerStorm use the Office365 Application ID 72782ba9-4490-4f03-8d82-562370ea3566 combined with the hardcoded User-Agent string containing "WebView/3.0" — a high-fidelity detection signature with very low false positive rate. FlowerStorm surged within ~10 days of Rockstar 2FA's infrastructure collapse in November 2024.

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Rockstar 2FA / FlowerStorm Detection
// Matches hardcoded AppId and WebView/3.0 User-Agent
#repo="azure_signinlogs"
AppId="72782ba9-4490-4f03-8d82-562370ea3566"
UserAgent="*WebView/3.0*"
| select([@timestamp, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, UserAgent,
          AppId, ResultType, RiskLevelDuringSignIn,
          Location, ConditionalAccessStatus])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)
queries.kql:
// KQL: Rockstar 2FA / FlowerStorm Detection
// Matches hardcoded AppId and WebView/3.0 User-Agent
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where AppId == "72782ba9-4490-4f03-8d82-562370ea3566"
| where UserAgent contains "WebView/3.0"
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, UserAgent,
          AppId, ResultType, RiskLevelDuringSignIn,
          Location, ConditionalAccessStatus
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Rockstar 2FA / FlowerStorm Detection")`
`comment("High-fidelity match on hardcoded AppId + WebView/3.0 User-Agent")`
index=azure sourcetype=azure:aad:signin
  AppId="72782ba9-4490-4f03-8d82-562370ea3566"
  UserAgent="*WebView/3.0*"
| table _time, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, UserAgent,
        AppId, ResultType, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, Location

references: Phishing kits and AiTM platforms: a comprehensive threat intelligence reference (2026)
falsepositives: Very low — this specific Application ID and User-Agent combination is not used by legitimate Microsoft client applications
